description:
When to leave (or visit) to beat traffic and weather, for any US
    trip.

    Answers "what's a good time to visit X", "when should I leave for
    the airport", "is 5 PM bad". It checks up to 16 departures across
    the window and returns, for each: drive minutes for that weekday and
    hour (TomTom historical traffic; live too within the hour), arrival
    time, the NWS forecast for the arrival hour with driving hazards
    flagged (snow, ice, fog, thunder), and how many incidents usually
    start on the route that hour (CommuteScout history since July 2026).

    `recommended` is the pick: quickest without severe weather, or with
    arrive_by, the latest departure that still arrives on time.
    `summary` states it in one or two sentences; `departures` has the
    whole curve if the user wants options. Times are in the origin's
    local time zone (`time_zone`).

    Pair with plan_trip for what is on the road right now.

arrive_by.description: Instead of a window: the time the user must arrive, destination local time ('9am', 'tomorrow 9:00'). Returns the latest safe departure.
arrive_by.title: Arrive By

day.description: 'today' (default), 'tomorrow', a weekday name, or YYYY-MM-DD, up to 60 days out.
day.title: Day

destination.description: An address, landmark or place anywhere in the US, e.g. '1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC' or 'Pike Place Market'. Include city and state when you have them. 'home', 'work' or a saved place's name use the user's saved places (see get_my_places). Leave origin out to start from the user's Home.
destination.title: Destination

destination_coords.description: Exact 'lat,lon' instead of a place name, e.g. '47.6097,-122.3421'. Wins over the place name.
destination_coords.title: Destination Coords

earliest.description: Earliest departure to consider, local time, e.g. '7am' or '07:00'. Default 6:00 AM.
earliest.title: Earliest

latest.description: Latest departure to consider, e.g. '8pm'. Default 9:00 PM.
latest.title: Latest

origin.description: An address, landmark or place anywhere in the US, e.g. '1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC' or 'Pike Place Market'. Include city and state when you have them. 'home', 'work' or a saved place's name use the user's saved places (see get_my_places). Leave origin out to start from the user's Home.
origin.title: Origin

origin_coords.description: Exact 'lat,lon' instead of a place name, e.g. '47.6097,-122.3421'. Wins over the place name.
origin_coords.title: Origin Coords

step_minutes.description: Spacing between departures checked. Default fits the window into 16.
step_minutes.title: Step Minutes

name: best_time_to_go
